# Technical Approach

## 1. Understanding of Requirements
Our team understands the requirements for modernizing the agency's IT infrastructure. We will leverage our experience as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) to deliver innovative solutions.

## 2. Technical Solution
We propose a cloud-native DevSecOps approach using Kubernetes for container orchestration. Our solution includes:
- Automated CI/CD pipelines
- Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
- Continuous monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

## 3. Management Approach
Our project manager has 15 years of federal IT experience. We will use Agile methodology with 2-week sprints and regular stakeholder reviews.

## 4. Past Performance
Aurelius has successfully completed 5 similar contracts totaling $12M in value. Our veteran-led team brings mission-critical expertise to every engagement.
